repeat_verification.peak_workers_scope: Main-workflow recovery controller session only; original session peak is not durably available.
repeat_verification.artifact_exchange: descriptors only; rows/traces/summary checksum-verified from atomic local artifacts

negative_control.scope: completed+1 in a separate static legacy_instant row copy; no additional rollout

independent_trace_replay.selection: first scenario seed per family, every deterministic policy/regime; fixed before outcomes
independent_trace_replay.scope: Fresh independent physical and sensor replay during recovery finalization; all rows audited.

observation_only_controller_replay.scope: Frozen evaluation validators: 41 durably accepted evaluations retained unchanged and one accepted evaluation validated after recovery; only recorded measured inputs.

source_and_sensor_boundary.checks: Fresh source timestamp, coldstart, common-noise, exact-ledger and same-source effective-staff checks.

repeat_verification.independent_statistics_check: The comparison worker and frozen comparison validator ran after recovery: all overall/source/family point means, paired effects/counts, NI slack and static-relative harm/CVaR checked; intervals use the unchanged frozen statistical module.
repeat_verification.timing_scope: Recovery start through finalization, including the interphase gap; excludes unknown original-run duration.
repeat_verification.inference_scope: A resumed repetition of the same frozen cases; no additional independent scenarios.

recovery.observations: Original execution handle was reported unavailable; this process acquired the original OS workspace lock.
recovery.method: Original Runtime.run on the unchanged stored job; ControllerInterrupted retry used its original budget.

error.message: Previous controller stopped during this attempt

recovery.counting_scope: 29,568 accepted deterministic episode rows and their declared simulated minutes. Uncommitted work from the interrupted first attempt is unknown and adds no independent cases.

accepted_controller_replay_provenance.scope: All accepted evaluation outputs passed the unchanged frozen validator, including exact observation-only controller replay. The finalizer freshly replays physics/sensors; it does not claim an additional full controller replay.

scope: One complete repetition of the same frozen validation, resumed through the original runtime after a technical interruption. This is reproducibility evidence, not additional independent cases.
exclusions: Runtime event times, wall time, absolute paths and runtime databases are not expected to be byte-identical.
